description: What Dependabot updated (pub in console/, NuGet in status/, the workflow actions), plus the images and tools pinned in yggdrasil.yml and ci/*.sh. The dockerfile and docker-compose managers are left out, as dependabot.yml left docker out (the platform images in platform/compose.yml are moved by hand).

packageRules.description: pub, NuGet and the workflow actions weekly, as Dependabot did (the preset has actions monthly).
The workflow actions in one pull request, as Dependabot grouped them.
templates/ are examples copied into other repositories: Dependabot never updated their pins, and they change by hand.
